method: Separate inspection of actual goals, full scope, instructions/criteria, provenance, allocation and apply. Model approval and execution are not educational acceptance. All trials/failures retained.

Retain that proportion limitation.

Explicit strategy-only opt-out preserves scope dispositions and publishes/applies zero committed activities and zero Quests, without a readiness claim.

No compulsory advanced topology or generic rereading.
